extracted_decision.rationale: Raw dumps bloat context and leak secrets; scrubbed rulings stay queryable.
extracted_decision.summary: Every stored decision must pass sanitize_text on all free-text fields plus a verify_clean gate; any surviving sensitive pattern raises and nothing is written (no bypass flag).
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Stricter writes; occasional false-positive blocks need rephrasing.

verbatim_quote.english_translation: Scrub gate fail-closes on EVERY root: free-text fields are sanitized, and if any sensitive pattern survives sanitizing, nothing is written — there is no bypass flag.
